known_parity_gaps: Finite scalar-Unicode payload domain, integers within i64/u64 and depth<=128; nonfinite/large-int/surrogate cache hits are explicit unsupported misses in Rust.
No scan/CLI cache policy, engine integration, concurrent lock timing, or native multi-OS acceptance is claimed. SQLite file bytes are not an output contract.
Directory vectors use synthetic override/base environments; home-directory fallback remains unit-tested but is not part of these vectors.
